The other files listed (PromotionsPanel, AccessibilityPanel, TransferMarket, ComplianceDashboard, AppealQueue, AdminDashboard, ReviewsSection) belong to other owners.

ApiError.details.fieldErrors is mapped to the matching <Field error> in PropertyPanel, AddRoomForm and CreatePropertyForm, which gives aria-invalid and aria-describedby. Focus moves to the first invalid field, and Status shows a summary such as 'N alanda sorun var'. The client-side invalid-amount check and calendar noChange are now Field errors on the price field (with focus). The field error text is a localized generic message ('Bu alanı kontrol edin.') because the server's zod messages are in English. DepositSettings belongs to another owner.

The card shows a single derived visibility sentence: live / pending / rejected (correct the number, then Save) / off. The checkbox label became 'Kaydettiğimde yayına al'. The data-testid=license-status span is kept. No warning about upcoming bookings when unpublishing (needs product decision).

The base price, calendar price, room price modifier and new-listing price fields are now type=text with inputMode=decimal and are parsed by parseAmountToMinor, using the currency's decimal places. Hints show example formats. Below the base price an aria-live preview reads 'Yeni gecelik fiyat: X (şu anki: Y)'. If the price changes by more than ±50%, useConfirm asks for confirmation before saving.

Added a RoomList component. Each room has a 'Satışa kapat/aç' button (sr-only room name, per-row pending state, Status) that calls PATCH /api/properties/[id]/rooms with {roomId, available}. A room edit form (name, capacity, bed type) was not added.
needs backend/API change: there is no GET for room availability (the route only has PUT).

results.summary: ReauthDialog now uses a native <dialog> with showModal(). That gives a focus trap and an inert background (top layer, so no portal is needed). Escape is handled through onCancel+preventDefault. The opening element is saved on mount and gets focus back on close. While busy, buttons use aria-disabled instead of disabled so focus does not fall to body. Triggers in PasskeyManager, SessionManager, AgentMandates and PrivacyCenter got the same treatment (busy/aria-disabled), so focus stays on the trigger and returns to it.

Same fix as F76. In addition, useReauth now keeps pending in a ref, and onDone/onCancel are fixed with useCallback. The dialog effect runs only on mount ([] dependencies), so a parent re-render no longer pulls focus back to the password field. The window keydown listener was removed. The password field got aria-invalid/aria-describedby, and focus returns to it after an error.

PrivacyCenter delete card: added a 'deleteEffects' list before confirmation (upcoming bookings cancelled under the cancellation terms, possibly no or partial refund; wallet credit deleted; transfer listings withdrawn; listings taken offline; existing host obligations must be resolved first). The acknowledge checkbox text now names these consequences concretely. Focus moves to the checkbox when the confirmation step opens. A per-user preview with counts and amounts (GET preview) needs a backend endpoint and was not done.

Same change as F20 (static consequence list plus concrete acknowledge text). Showing the summary of active bookings and obligations before confirming needs a preview endpoint (backend), so it was not done. The extra friction step (typing the email) is a product decision and was left out.

Added a client 'CookiePreferencesButton' export to PrivacyCenter.tsx. It deletes the cookie_consent cookie and reloads the page, so the cookie banner opens again. The button is placed in the cookies section of src/app/privacy/page.tsx. The privacy.notice.cookies.body text no longer tells users to delete the cookie by hand and points to the button instead (patch). Adding the same button next to the 'Cookies' link in Footer needs another owner, so it is in crossOwner.

Added a new 'useAccountErrorText' hook (exported from ReauthDialog.tsx). It builds on useErrorText (common.errors / network error) and adds account-specific mappings: ReauthCancelled, NotAllowedError/InvalidStateError, and RATE_LIMITED/REAUTH_RATE_LIMITED/KYC_RATE_LIMITED mapped to account.errors.codes.*. Raw messages from client-side (non-API) errors are never shown. Server messages, which exist only in Turkish, are shown only when locale=tr; other locales get the caller's translated fallback. errorMessage/err.message usage was removed from AgentMandates, IdentityVerification and PrivacyCenter. ReauthCancelledError no longer carries a user-facing message. Not done: the ui.tsx errorMessage default and the api-client 'İstek başarısız' message belong to other owners (crossOwner).

SessionManager and PasskeyManager now use useAccountErrorText instead of err.message/passkeyErrorMessage. In ReauthDialog, WebAuthn errors map to t('passkeys.cancelled'/'alreadyRegistered'), UNAUTHORIZED maps to t('reauth.wrongPassword') for password attempts and t('failed') for passkey, and network errors map to common.errors.network. 'Failed to fetch' and Turkish server text no longer reach the EN interface.

SessionManager: closing the 'This device' session no longer calls DELETE+reauth. After confirmation it calls logout() directly (which closes the current session on the server) and goes to /login. Other sessions: a 404 NOT_FOUND is now treated as 'already closed' (sessions.alreadyClosed), and load() runs on both success and error, so the list never stays stale.

AgentMandates amount field: type=text inputMode=decimal autoComplete=off, controlled. min/step removed (this also removes the mouse-wheel issue). Value parsed with parseAmountToMinor: '1.500' gives 150000 and too many decimals give null. A separate amountFormat message covers bad format and amountInvalid covers <=0. Focus moves to the field on error. Added an example format in the hint (amountHint) and a live preview below the field with aria-live=polite, formatted with f.money ('Limit: ₺1.500,00'). The currency select is controlled so the preview uses the right currency. toMinor/float rounding removed. The currency adornment was skipped (visual/layout change).

AgentMandates revoke now asks first through useConfirm (tone=danger, initial focus on Cancel). The body states the amount limit, the expiry date and that the action cannot be undone. During the request the button gets busy={revoking===nonce}, which prevents double submission. The button has min-h-[44px] on mobile. Errors are shown with errorText(…, revokeFailed).

PrivacyCenter: for ApiError ACCOUNT_HAS_OBLIGATIONS, err.details (hostedBookings/pendingPayouts/openClaims) is read and shown inside the delete card as a list with counts and links (/host, /host/payouts, /resolution). The delete error moved from the top of the page into the card (Status). Other errors are localized. Showing the obligations before confirmation and reauth needs a pre-check endpoint (backend), so it was not done.

- Changed: resultCount, noResultsHint.
- New: noResultsDestination, noResultsDestinationHint, noResultsFiltersHint, allStays, skipToResults, loadMore, guestCountDefault, mapPrice.{total,perNight}, filters.{priceTotal,pricePerNight,suffixTotal,suffixNight,minLabel,maxLabel,priceHint,priceInvalid,priceOrder,anyType,toggle,clearAll}, flex.pickDates, edit.{toggle,destination,checkIn,checkOut,guests,submit,datesBoth,datesOrder,guestsInvalid}.
- The old filters.price, minPrice, maxPrice, minPlaceholder and maxPlaceholder keys are no longer used by this page; they can stay in the files.

Price filter semantics now follow the server: the tax-inclusive total when dates are set, otherwise the nightly price, in each listing's own currency because the page sends no display currency. The fields commit with a 500 ms debounce and do not send a request while min > max (the API would return 400).

The page uses Button's busy prop and className from ui.tsx, and useCompareSelection from components/compare, which I only read.

{home.featuredError}

SearchBar.tsx has a new CounterRow subcomponent. Each row is role=group with aria-labelledby (useId) and has row-specific button names (bar.decreaseAdults/increaseAdults/…Children/…Rooms). The visible number is aria-hidden, and an sr-only aria-live=polite aria-atomic span announces '{label}: {count}'. At the limits (adults 1/30, children 0/10, rooms 1/min(30, adults)) the buttons get aria-disabled plus a guarded no-op instead of disabled, so focus is not lost, and aria-disabled:opacity-50 shows the state with no color change. Same change as F40: row-specific labels, group role, live announcement, aria-disabled at the limits and 44px buttons on mobile.

DestinationAutocomplete.tsx now follows the APG combobox pattern. activeIndex state drives aria-activedescendant. ArrowDown/ArrowUp wrap around and open the list when it is closed. Enter selects the active option, and with no active option the form submits as before. Escape closes the list, a second Escape clears the value, and Tab closes it. Options are li[role=option][id=destination-opt-N] with aria-selected={idx===activeIndex}, and mousedown preventDefault means they are not Tab stops and focus stays in the input. The heading moved outside the listbox as p#destination-listbox-heading, and the listbox uses aria-labelledby. The empty state is an aria-hidden p outside the listbox. A persistent sr-only role=status reports searching, '{count} suggestions' (new key autocomplete.count) or noResults. The root's onBlur closes the list when relatedTarget is outside it. The active option uses scrollIntoView. On !res.ok the options are cleared. aria-expanded and aria-controls now follow whether the listbox is actually shown.
Same change as F56: keyboard model, activedescendant, Escape/Tab/blur closing, and focus stays in the input after a selection.
Same change as F56: valid listbox > option structure, heading and empty state moved outside the listbox, aria-selected bound to the active option, and a role=status announcement.
Same change as F56: the list closes on root onBlur (relatedTarget check) and on Tab or Escape.

Destination: focus stays in the input after a selection, because the option is not a focusable element and mousedown is prevented. SearchBar: once the date range is complete, handleDateChange closes the picker and calls dateButtonRef.current.focus().
Same change as F56: activedescendant, arrow-key contract and no extra Tab stops. Home/End were left with their default caret movement in the text field.
A persistent sr-only p role=status sits outside the listbox. It reads searching, autocomplete.count (TR '{count} öneri', EN plural) or noResults.

SearchBar: Escape (onKeyDown on the wrapper) closes the picker and returns focus to the trigger. A document pointerdown outside the picker closes it. When the range is complete, focus returns to the trigger. The trigger has aria-haspopup=dialog and aria-controls. The popover wrapper has role=dialog and aria-label={bar.datesDialog}. The hold/plan/invite cases on checkout/cart and SplitPayPanel belong to another owner.

New CartItemRow component: Adults and Children are controlled fields with a local draft that resyncs from the server value whenever item changes (adjust-state-during-render pattern). Changes commit on blur or Enter. The commit checks Number.isInteger and the 1–20 / 0–20 limits. On invalid input the field gets aria-invalid plus an aria-describedby error below it (cart.item.adultsRange/childrenRange: limits plus the saved value), and the field reverts to the saved value. If the server rejects the change, the draft is also reset to the server value. Server error codes are translated through cart.errors.*.

results.summary: In wave 1, DateRangePicker was changed to measure its container and drop to 1 month when narrow (TWO_MONTH_MIN_WIDTH), and day buttons became 'aspect-square w-full min-w-0', so they fit their cells with no overlap in the 395px sidebar or at 360px. In the widget I only connected onClose and added a close button (see F361/F362).

Capacity is now checked in the client, in the UI language. When guestCount > selectedRoom.capacity, no quote is requested (roomId undefined), a widget.overCapacity / overCapacityNoRoom message is shown, and the guest and room selects get aria-invalid plus aria-describedby linked to the message. Room options too small for the guest count show the 'roomOptionTooSmall' label. If a room fits, a 'switch to that room' button (Button secondary) appears and the switch is announced in the aria-live area. The server error code (OVER_CAPACITY) needs a backend change.

Every plan row now shows its difference from the cheapest plan ('+%X' or 'en uygun fiyat'), calculated from priceModifierBps. A plan name that matches the start of the refund text ('İade edilemez / İade edilemez') is no longer repeated. The refundable/nonRefundable texts are more concrete, and an 'İptal koşullarını gör' link points to the page's #policies section. A per-plan free-cancellation date needs the backend to return it with the plan.

On a 401, the login redirect URL now carries the selections (checkIn, checkOut, guests, roomId, ratePlanId) plus intent=add-to-cart, built with loginHref. When the user comes back, the add is completed once as soon as the quote is ready, and intent is removed from the URL. For signed-out users (useSession) the hint says 'giriş istenecek; seçimleriniz korunur'. The button has aria-busy and aria-describedby, and the extra role=alert was removed. A context heading on the login page belongs to another owner.

Guest options are now 1..max(largest room capacity, current guestCount), so a value of 7+ from search shows up in the select. If it exceeds capacity, a visible warning plus a room suggestion is shown (as in F155). Carrying children separately belongs to SearchBar (crossOwner).

In the widget, guest options are generated dynamically, the value from search is kept, and capacity overflow produces a warning. A shared GuestPicker, carrying adults/children/rooms in the URL, and the real children value need SearchBar, cart and the URL contract (crossOwner).

Added triggerRef and closeCalendar(returnFocus). Once the check-out date is picked, or on Escape (DateRangePicker onClose) or the close button, focus returns to the date button via requestAnimationFrame. The trigger also got aria-haspopup=dialog, focusRing and min-h-[44px].

Escape now closes the picker through its onClose. While it is open, mousedown and focusin listeners on document close it when the target is outside datesRef. A visible 'Takvimi kapat' button (Button secondary) was added under the picker. The picker root already has role=dialog and aria-label.

Options are 1..max(capacity, guestCount). Rooms that are too small are labelled in the option text ('… · N misafir için küçük'). Instead of switching rooms silently, there is a 'switch to the right room' button, and the switch is announced in the polite live area.

In the widget, values are no longer lost or displayed wrongly (dynamic options plus a capacity warning). A single guest model across the SearchBar, PropertyCard, checkout and cart chain needs other owners.

guestCount is always in the option list, so the displayed value matches the priced value. When it exceeds capacity, no quote is requested and an inline warning plus a room suggestion is shown. Aligning the SearchBar upper limit is crossOwner.

When plans.length === 1, a static line under the room select shows the plan name, refund status and meal info, and the policy link appears whenever there is at least one plan. A cancellation line in QuoteBreakdown and in the checkout summary needs a server-side quote.cancellation summary (backend) and the checkout page (other owner).

Refund texts are now more concrete ('İade edilebilir (iptal koşullarına göre)', 'İade edilemez: iptal ederseniz ücret geri ödenmez'), and a link goes to the cancellation terms section (#policies). A per-plan free-cancellation date and refund percentage need the backend to return them.

The widget maps the useQuote code: SOLD_OUT, RESTRICTED and NOT_FOUND are shown from booking.widget.errors.* in the UI language, and unknown codes fall back to the server text. Capacity is checked in the client (F155). QuoteBreakdown translates fee and tax labels by code (F371). AddToCartButton and PriceInsight now use the shared useErrorText instead of err.message. Restriction parameters (minStay, date) are not passed to the client, and the capacity error needs its own code (backend/useQuote).

The widget button text is now 'Rezervasyona devam et' / 'Continue to booking'. Under it there is a feedforward hint linked with aria-describedby ('Henüz ödeme alınmaz…'). The step indicator and the checkout button text belong to the checkout and booking page owners.
Duplicate of F369. Widget label and feedforward are fixed; the checkout label, the step indicator (aria-current=step) and the hold-time note are crossOwner.

QuoteBreakdown: the VAT, ACCOMMODATION_TAX and SERVICE_FEE codes go through quote.taxKind.* in fee and tax rows and in the includedTax label, and unknown codes fall back to the server label. The TR texts are the same as before, so e2e 'Konaklama vergisi' is preserved. The RevenueDashboard / revenue-engine part belongs to another owner.

RnplChoice now shows dueAt and freeCancellationUntil as date + time + short time zone name through the payment.rnpl.moment message, using f.date(…,'long',tz) and f.time(…,tz). tz is the optional offer.timeZone if present, otherwise the viewer's time zone (no longer UTC). The TR stepFreeCancel text was changed to '… saatine kadar'. Having the server return the property's timeZone in the offer is a backend change.

WalletCreditOption now calls onChange(0) on unmount (an onChange ref plus an effect with empty deps, so changing the callback does not cause a reset). The hidden credit no longer survives after RNPL is selected. Also, the amount field is now type=text with inputMode=decimal and parseAmountToMinor ('1.250,50' is accepted), linked to the hint and error through aria-describedby. aria-invalid is set only when invalid, the extra role=alert was removed, and the hint includes an example format.

extraChanges: BookingWidget: the date label is now a span plus aria-describedby (a label element with no target was being used); the date button and selects got min-h-[44px]; the price area got aria-busy={loading}; rate plan labels got min-h-[44px] on mobile.
PriceInsight: the 'Fiyat alarmı kur' button got aria-busy and min-h-[44px] on mobile.

Added safeRedirect(raw) to AuthCard.tsx. It accepts a value only if it starts with '/', does not start with '//' or '/\', and resolves to the same origin; anything else becomes '/'. Both the password and passkey paths in login now use it through a shared goBack() function, and register uses it after success.

EMAIL_TAKEN shows as a field error on email. The name inputs now have minLength=2. Before sending, the form checks name length and that the password has 8+ characters and a digit. In forgot-password, a 400 becomes a separate 'invalid' state: the email field shows forgot.invalidEmail and gets focus.

Same fix as F36. In reset-password, fieldErrors.password shows as an error on the password field and that field gets focus. fieldErrors.token, or a VALIDATION_ERROR without field errors, switches the page to the invalid-link state.

reset-password reads the token as soon as the page loads (useSearchParam, safe for hydration). If the token is missing or shorter than 20 characters, the form is not shown. Instead the page shows an invalidTitle card with the invalidLink notice, a primary 'Yeni bağlantı iste' link to /forgot-password and a 'Girişe dön' link. A link that turns out invalid or expired on submit goes to the same card. The form screen and the done screen also got a back-to-login link.

A malformed token is caught on the client, and an expired one is caught on the first submit. The client now checks the password before sending, so the user no longer fixes the password first and only then learns the link is invalid.

Added a useAuthErrorText() hook to AuthCard.tsx. It maps UNAUTHORIZED, EMAIL_TAKEN, RATE_LIMITED, POW_REQUIRED, VALIDATION_ERROR, SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE, EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED and network errors to auth.errors.*. Unknown codes fall back to the page's own *.failed key, so server text is never shown. Login, register, forgot, reset and PasskeyLoginButton all use it. Login computes the redirect with safeRedirect(useSearchParam('redirect')) and passes it through withRedirect() on the register and forgot-password links. Register reads the parameter, goes there after success (router.push(redirect), or through the Continue link on the success screen), and its 'Giriş Yap' link carries the parameter back. results.summary: Before saving, a DSA notice decision now opens a useConfirm dialog (danger tone for REMOVED). The dialog shows the decision, the content URL, the ground, the effect (listing taken down / emails to both parties) and that the decision cannot be changed. Pressing Enter in the single-line field also goes through this dialog. AppealQueue's 'İtiraz kararını kaydet' got the same confirmation, worded by outcome (upheldRemove/upheldRestore/rejected). Files: ComplianceDashboard.tsx decide(), AppealQueue.tsx decide().

Takedown form: on blur of the listing ID field, the listing is looked up via GET /api/properties/{id} and an aria-live preview appears ('Kaldırılacak ilan: {title} · {city}', or a not-found warning). Submitting opens a danger confirmation that names the listing. While the request runs, the button has busy (aria-disabled + aria-busy) and reads 'Kaydediliyor…'; a pendingRef guard drops a second submit. On success the form is reset with form.reset() and the preview is cleared. Not done: the host name is not in the public API response, and the server-side idempotency key needs a backend change.

NoticeForm: details.fieldErrors from the 400 response is mapped to per-field i18n messages (errors.*) and passed to Field's error prop, so aria-invalid and aria-describedby are set. The first invalid field gets focus. Client side, the explanation is checked with trim().length>=20 and the email with a regex that requires a TLD before sending. Each error clears once the user fixes it while typing. The button uses busy instead of disabled, so focus is not lost.

NoticeForm sent state: the Card and an aria-live region stay mounted the whole time, and only their content changes. An h2 'Bildiriminiz alındı' (tabIndex=-1, scroll-mt-24) and the reference message are shown. A useEffect calls scrollIntoView({block:'start'}) and then focus().
Page titles are handled globally (wave 1). Per the task instruction I added no title or metadata, so trust/page.tsx and admin/compliance/page.tsx were not changed.

AppealForm: when the reason is shorter than 20 characters, focus moves to #appeal-reason, so the label, aria-invalid and the error text are read together. The textarea onChange clears the error once the trimmed length reaches 20. No role=alert was added (it was unnecessary). The button uses busy instead of disabled, and a guard blocks double submits.

Notices, appeals and the accessibility queue: each item has an h3 with tabIndex=-1 (notice-/appeal-/a11y-{id}-title). Before an action, the neighbouring item (next, or previous if there is none) is stored. After reload, a useEffect moves focus to that item's heading, or to the Card heading ({id}-title, tabindex=-1 added) when the list is empty. When a takedown is closed, focus goes to that row's status text (td-{id}-state).

Each action now has its own pending state and a pendingRef guard. While a request runs, the related Button gets busy (aria-disabled + aria-busy) and the label 'Kaydediliyor…'; a second submit or click is ignored. This covers takedown create and close, notice decisions, appeal decisions, and verify/unverify. Not done: the takedown POST would need an Idempotency-Key, but the route does not support one, so that part needs a backend/API change.

The global Status at the top was removed. Action errors now appear in a Status right under each item's or form's submit button. Success messages show next to the takedown form or row, and in the card's Status when the item drops out of the list. Load errors appear inside the related card with a 'Tekrar dene' (reload) button. The three error sources are no longer merged into one string.

The listing ID field now has autoComplete=off, spellCheck=false, a hint, a title/city preview on blur, and a 'İlan hemen yayından kaldırılsın mı?' danger confirmation before submit, so Enter also goes through the confirmation. Not done: a full listing-search combobox needs an admin listing-search API, which needs a backend change.

'Kapat' now opens an inline form in the row instead of closing straight away. It has a required 'Kapatma gerekçesi' textarea (minLength 3, maxLength 2000) with a feedforward hint saying the request cannot be reopened and the host may republish the listing, plus 'Talebi kapat' (danger, busy) and 'Vazgeç' buttons. The resolution value comes from this field; t('defaultResolution') is no longer used.

Notices and takedowns now have separate loading, error and empty states: role=status common.loading while loading, an error plus 'Tekrar dene' on failure, and 'Bekleyen bildirim yok' / 'Kayıtlı talep yok' only when data is an empty array. AppealQueue and AccessibilityReviewQueue also got a loading state.

Added break-all to the notice content URL, min-w-0 to its container, and break-words to the explanation paragraph. Long text in the appeal reason, takedown rows and accessibility notes also got break-words. No colors were changed.

The decision select is now controlled and required, and starts on an empty disabled 'Seçin…' option. The ground select is only rendered when decision === REMOVED, also with an empty default and required. In AppealQueue no radio is pre-selected: required, a 'Bir sonuç seçin.' hint linked with aria-describedby, and if nothing is chosen an item-level error is shown and focus goes to the first radio. The ground select there also starts empty and is required. The radio labels are min-h-[44px] on mobile.

NoticeForm and AppealForm: the Card and its aria-live container stay mounted in every state, and only the content changes, so the message is announced. A focusable heading (h2 sentTitle / h3 sentTitle) is focused and scrolled into view in a useEffect.

results.summary: I did not switch to /10. The codebase scale is 1–5: the review API validates z.number().int().min(1).max(5), ranking.ts divides by 5, the shared RatingBadge and property.ratingOutOf show '/5', and listing-compare.ts:209 already says '/5'. The '8,9/5' comes from seed data on a 10-point scale (prisma/seed.ts:311+). Package p006 (crossOwner cards#6) is halving those seed values, after which the compare page shows e.g. '4,5/5'. Changing ratingValue to /10 here would make it disagree with the API and every other badge.

The scroll container already had role=region, an aria-label and tabIndex=0. Row headers and the corner cell are now sticky with left-0, z-10 and an opaque bg-white. The table uses border-separate border-spacing-0 so sticky cells keep their borders. Listing columns get min-w-[11rem]. The corner th used to be class sr-only (position:absolute), which takes it out of the table grid and shifts the column headers left. It is now a normal sticky cell with sr-only text inside.

Splitting the table from the AI commentary needs changes in src/lib/ai/listing-compare.ts and src/app/api/compare/route.ts, which I don't own. The plan is in crossOwner. Once those endpoints exist, the page will load the table first and show the commentary section with aria-busy and a skeleton while it loads.

useLoader, which converted errors to strings, is replaced by a local useCompareData hook that keeps the error object. ApiError.code is mapped to new compare.errors.{VALIDATION_ERROR,NOT_FOUND} keys in both locales; other codes go through the shared useErrorText (common.errors.* or common.unexpectedError). The generic errorHelp paragraph only shows for unmapped errors. Retry now uses Button busy while it reloads.

The initial-loading paragraph and the Suspense fallback now have role=status. useCompareData exposes a loading flag that is true whenever the request URL (ids, dates or locale) or the retry version changes. While loading, the old table stays visible and is marked aria-busy, and an always-present role=status paragraph shows 'Karşılaştırma güncelleniyor…' / 'Updating comparison…'.
Compare dates now use f.date(x, "medium"), giving '12 Eki 2026' / 'Oct 12, 2026'. I did not add a weekday because format.ts is not my file. The same change for the search header is in crossOwner.

Every listing tied for first gets the badge, and nobody gets it when all are equal. 'Cheapest' needs 2 or more priced listings in one currency. A non-refundable listing scores -Infinity, so it can never be 'most flexible', and when all listings are non-refundable none gets the badge. If hasPasskey is not passed, the dialog calls GET /api/account/passkeys (requireAuth only) when it opens. results.summary: The current session is now always sorted first; the rest keep the server's last-seen order. The current row's button reads 'Bu cihazda çıkış yap' (revokeCurrent). Every other row gets aria-label revokeLabel 'Oturumu kapat: {device}, son etkinlik {date}'. After the list reloads, an effect moves focus to the next row's button, else the previous one, else the h2 (now tabIndex=-1). For 'others' it goes to the h2, and after a successful retry too. was used. It is replaced by ui.tsx's Status component: success text goes to an always-mounted role=status region, and errors go to role=alert with icon and prefix.

'DEAD mesajlar' became 'Kalıcı olarak başarısız mesajlar'. The SupportAdmin, Compliance, AppealQueue and Mailbox parts belong to their own owners.

The current code already used Button busy, but with one busyId per card, so when one row's request finished it unlocked another row whose request was still running. Added a useRowBusy() Set lock keyed by row id. It is used in the outbox requeue, event act, fraud resolve and moderation decide actions, and each action also checks isBusy first. The event proposal and role forms now use busy, which keeps focus, instead of disabled, and also check for busy before sending.

Row action results now appear next to the row that was clicked: a RowNotice inside the row, or at the same list position (QueueList) if the record left the list after a decision or filter change. Messages name the record (e.g. '{title}: onay geri alındı.', 'Rezervasyon X: meşru olarak işaretlendi.', '{name}: {error}'). Each card keeps an sr-only aria-live region (RowAnnouncer) for screen readers. Errors now go through useErrorText instead of err.message.

The event queue now has a status filter: a group of aria-pressed buttons labelled Önerildi/Onaylı/Reddedildi/Geri alındı, each with a count, defaulting to Önerildi. Events are sorted by start date (a note on screen says so). A city filter appears when there is more than one city, and 'Daha fazla göster (N kaldı)' shows 20 more at a time. There is also a filtered empty state. After a new proposal is created, the filter switches to Önerildi / all cities so the new item is visible. The server still returns at most 100 events (crossOwner).

Every repeated row button in AdminDashboard now has aria-label = t('rowAction', {action, name}). The name starts with the visible label, so voice control still works, followed by the record: event title, 'Rezervasyon <id>', '“{property}” yorumu', or the outbox eventType · aggregateId. Applies to Onayla/Reddet/Onayı geri al, Meşru/Dolandırıcılık, Yayınla/Kaldır and Yeniden kuyruğa al. PayoutAdmin, ClaimList and SupportAdmin belong to their owners.

Confirmed the role select defaulted to HOST and the ID field was never cleared. The select now starts empty and is required ('Rol seçin' placeholder). The confirm dialog for ADMIN (danger) was already in place. On success the form clears, and the message names the user and says their sessions were closed; it shows 'from → to' when the API returns previousRole. Searching by email or name and showing the current role before submitting need a user lookup API that doesn't exist (see crossOwner and notes).

Confirmed: the row buttons had no context (no aria-describedby or sr-only text). Fixed in AdminDashboard with aria-label 'Action: record name' on every repeated row button, as described for F465. The other listed files belong to their owners.

Confirmed: diagnostic cards came first and there was no in-page navigation. Added <nav aria-label='Pano bölümleri'> with anchor links that include counts (e.g. 'Dolandırıcılık inceleme kuyruğu (3 bekliyor)', 'Outbox (2 başarısız)'). Cards are reordered to fraud, moderation, events, roles, then outbox, experiments, LLM. Queue card titles show the same counts. The fraud, reviews, events and outbox loaders moved up into AdminDashboard and are passed down to the cards, so there are no duplicate requests.

Within AdminDashboard: added a summary strip with counts (the same nav as F641), and queue cards now come before the system cards. Counts for the compliance, payout, claim and support links live in src/app/admin/page.tsx, which another package owns (crossOwner).

Confirmed: cards were empty until their data arrived. Added a LoadingNote (common.loading, aria-live='polite') that shows while there is no data and no error, in every data card: LLM, outbox, events, fraud, moderation and experiments. PayoutAdmin and SupportAdmin belong to their owners.

The default response stays unchanged. The UI currently filters, sorts and pages on the client but only ever sees the 100 newest events (take:100).

crossOwner.change: Show pending counts on the compliance, payout, claim and support queue links (e.g. 'Destek kuyruğu (4)', DSA with SLA overrun), using the same nav.pending pattern as admin.nav.pending in the admin namespace.
crossOwner.statusNote: src/app/admin/page.tsx (r008): partially_fixed — /admin now renders a new AdminQueuePagesNav: the same items, labels and order as AdminPagesNav, with pending counts via the existing admin.nav.pending ICU key (e.g. 'Destek kuyruğu (4 bekliyor)'). The counts come from a new small read-only ADMIN route GET /api/admin/queue-counts: claims OPEN/ESCALATED, support OPEN/IN_PROGRESS, and compliance = notices RECEIVED + appeals PENDING + takedowns RECEIVED. results.summary: I added a new shared hook, useAdminErrorText(), in src/components/admin/admin-error-text.ts. It maps the API codes NOT_FOUND, INVALID_STATE, CONFLICT, LAST_ADMIN, FORBIDDEN, VALIDATION_ERROR and RATE_LIMITED to admin.errors.* in both locales; network errors and the generic codes still go through useErrorText. Every dashboard action now uses it. When a row action gets a stale response (isStaleRecord: NOT_FOUND or INVALID_STATE), the row shows admin.staleRecord ('handled by another admin; the list was refreshed') and the list reloads. The role form has its own messages for NOT_FOUND and FORBIDDEN.

Most of this was already in place from p047: a per-row useRowBusy lock, Button busy (aria-disabled and aria-busy, repeat clicks ignored) and the role submit kept busy. I added aria-busy on each queue row (outbox, events, fraud, moderation) while that row's action runs.

Row messages already named the item (from p047). Approve and roll-back now use the repriced count from the API response: '{title}: proposal approved; N night prices recalculated. You can undo it from the Approved filter.' Reject falls back to events.done.*. The SupportAdmin part is passed on as a crossOwner request.

Event rows now show the category (translated through events.categories.*) and the source (llm:<mode> shown as 'AI extraction (Demo/Live)'). Editing a proposal before approval needs a PATCH endpoint, which does not exist, so I did not add the inline edit form. The API part is requested in crossOwner.

A new useAdminLoader wraps useLoader and records when the last load finished. A new RefreshBar on every card (fraud, moderation, events, outbox, experiments, LLM) shows 'Last updated: {time}' and a Refresh button labelled 'Refresh: {card}' that shows busy while loading. The four queue cards also refresh silently every 60 s while the tab is visible and online. When another admin has already handled a record (404 or invalid state), the row says so and the list reloads.

A new LimitNote warns 'Only {count} records are shown; more may be waiting…' when a list reaches its server limit (fraud 100, moderation 50, events 100, failed outbox 50; listed in SERVER_LIMITS). Totals and cursor paging need API changes, requested in crossOwner.

Fraud rows now show the check time (dateTime of createdAt) and the score on its 0–100 scale. Moderation rows now link the property title to /property/{propertyId} and show the review date; the API already returned propertyId and createdAt. The booking amount needs the fraud API to include booking data, and the SupportAdmin part belongs to another file; both are in crossOwner.

Fraud booking and user IDs are now shortened, with the full value in a title tooltip and a Copy button that copies the full ID and announces 'Copied'. A new 'Change role' button on each fraud row fills the role form with that user's ID and moves focus to the field. Moderation rows link to the property. I could not link booking IDs because there is no admin booking view (GET /api/bookings/[id] only serves the booking owner). The other files are in crossOwner.

Fraud decisions, rule codes, outbox statuses and role options were already translated by p047. I translated the remaining raw values in this file: the LLM setting (auto/live/demo through llm.modes.*), event categories and event sources. The fraud score now shows as '{score}/100'; the 0–100 scale comes from the FRAUD_* thresholds in app-config. SupportAdmin intent and ui.tsx:230 are in crossOwner.

The fraud buttons already used verb labels ('Mark as legitimate' / 'Mark as fraud'). The fraud card now has a hint explaining what each decision does and that marking fraud cannot be undone here. Each 'Approve' button on a proposed event is linked through aria-describedby to a visible line: 'Approving immediately recalculates prices for nights around {start}–{end} in {city}.' The PayoutAdmin pause hint is in crossOwner.

Confirmed. A plain reorder would have been wrong: the expiry sweep sets remainingMinor to 0 and moves the rest to expiredMinor, so an expired unused lot would show 'Kullanıldı'. The sr-only label is now a visible label that depends on role: GUEST sees chat.inputLabelToHost and HOST sees chat.inputLabelToGuest. The safety notice

Added a live counter (chat.counter, id msg-count) linked through aria-describedby. When the text crosses 90% of the limit or goes over it, an sr-only polite live region announces it once per state change (counterNear/counterOver). A send over the limit is blocked on the client and the text is kept. A tooLong error (with the over count) is linked to the field with aria-invalid and msg-error, and it clears itself once the text is short enough. The limit comes from an optional thread.maxLength and falls back to 2000. The server part is listed in crossOwner.

The EventSource now has open and error handlers. When it reopens, the thread is fetched again with GET and merged by id and sorted by createdAt. A GET also runs when the tab becomes visible again. While the GET is in flight, live events are buffered instead of dropped. On error the UI shows a role=status message: 'reconnecting' while the state is CONNECTING, or 'stopped' plus a Reconnect button when it is CLOSED (for example a 429). While not live there is a 30s fallback poll. Last-Event-ID / id: was not added because the GET-on-reopen fills the gap.

On a successful send, only the sent prefix is removed from the latest text (tracked in textRef). Anything typed during the send is kept and fromDraft is reset. The busy state now records whether a send or a draft is running. The send button reads chat.sending and the draft button reads chat.drafting, each with aria-busy.

If the textarea already has text when a draft arrives, the draft goes into a separate group box instead. The box shows a title, the draft text, an LlmBadge (llmMode), the AI notice, and three buttons: Replace / Append / Dismiss. Focus moves to the box. After Replace or Append, a 'Restore my previous text' undo button appears. The AI notice now sits in a role=status region next to an <LlmBadge mode={llmMode}/> and is linked to the textarea (msg-ai-notice). Focus goes back to the textarea afterwards.

When m.fromAiDraft is true, the meta line shows a small 'Yapay zekâ taslağından' pill with data-ai-generated="true" (marked aria-hidden). The same text is added to the sr-only sender prefix, so screen readers hear it before the message body.

results.summary: Confirmed: a typed code stayed in local state and checkout sent only the applied coupon. CouponField now treats the field as dirty when the trimmed, uppercased value is non-empty and differs from the applied code. While it is dirty, a native submit listener on the enclosing form (input.form) calls preventDefault and stopPropagation, so the checkout's React onSubmit never sends the booking. The listener also moves focus to the coupon field and shows the polite hint "Bu kupon kodunu uygulamadınız. Uygula'ya basın ya da alanı temizleyin." Clicking Apply or clearing the field removes the block. This also covers retrySubmit's requestSubmit. No checkout change is needed.

Confirmed: the problem was real (CouponField.tsx:31-32 and checkout:251). Fixed by the same submit guard as F579, which needs no checkout change and so no onDirtyChange prop: the dirty field blocks submit, shows the hint and gets focus.

Added an optional `loading` prop. When the shown code is the applied one and the quote is loading, the Apply button reads "Uygulanıyor…", gets aria-busy and aria-disabled with cursor-wait, and ignores clicks and Enter. The status now names the code ("{code} kuponu uygulandı."). The input gets aria-invalid on a non-APPLIED status or a local hint. Local hints sit in an always-present role="status" container. The server result

stays non-live on purpose, because checkout's sr-only priceStatus already announces it (F591) and a second live region would read it twice. The busy state only appears once checkout passes loading={quoteLoading} (crossOwner).

Removed the CSS `uppercase` class. The value is now uppercased with String.prototype.toUpperCase, which does not depend on locale and matches the server's normalisation, both on change and for the initial value from the URL, so Turkish "i" becomes "I" and never "İ". The caret position is kept when the case changes.

The input now has min-w-0 flex-1 (in place of w-full) and Apply has shrink-0 whitespace-nowrap, so the row can't overflow, even while Apply shows "Uygulanıyor…". On every width, "Kaldır" moved to a separate result row under the field (status text + Kaldır, flex-wrap) and also got shrink-0 whitespace-nowrap.

aria-invalid is set on an error. couponStatus.NOT_FOUND now tells the user what to do ("Kupon bulunamadı. Kodu kontrol edip yeniden uygulayın ya da kaldırın."); checkout's priceStatus uses the same key, and the text still reads correctly there. Clicking Apply with an empty field and no applied coupon now shows "Kupon kodu girin." in the live hint. The value is normalised with toUpperCase in place of the CSS text-transform.

results.summary: Added two optional props to WalletCreditOption. With rnplSelected, the box stays visible as a disabled fieldset with an unchecked checkbox and an explanatory note (wallet.checkout.rnplUnavailable) linked by aria-describedby. Its credit/amount state is kept for when the guest switches back. onLoaded(shown) fires once when the credit fetch resolves or fails, so the parent can reserve space or wait before showing the card form. The layout shift and hide-on-RNPL behaviour live in BookingActions and RnplOption; the needed changes are listed in crossOwner.

On blur, an amount over the limit is now clamped to maxUsableMinor and a polite note (wallet.checkout.clamped) is shown and linked to the input. Blur runs before the pay click, so the over-limit case no longer silently charges the full amount to the card. Added optional onValidityChange(valid) and inputRef props so the parent can block payment and move focus when the text can't be parsed. The pay button already shows the amount to be charged (BookingActions:448). Blocking the submit is a BookingActions change (crossOwner).

Already fixed in the current code. The credit field is type="text" inputMode="decimal" and is parsed with parseAmountToMinor; unparseable text becomes -1 and shows an error instead of 0, and the hint already shows an example format (150,50). The other money fields listed (HostDashboard, search page) also use parseAmountToMinor now; the remaining type="number" inputs there are capacity and guest counts, not money. Currency was added to the credit label (see F1394).

aria-describedby was already present. The error is now validated on blur instead of on every keystroke and clears as soon as the user edits again. It renders inside an always-mounted aria-live="polite" container together with the clamp note. aria-invalid only appears while the error is shown, and describedby lists the hint plus whichever error or clamp note is visible.

The field no longer jumps to 0, because the typed text is kept as a draft. A remaining bug is fixed: clearing the field or typing invalid text and then leaving it used to display "-0,01"; invalid text now stays as typed and shows the error. The label now includes the currency symbol from Intl (new key amountWithCurrency, e.g. "Kullanılacak kredi (₺)"). It is a separate label using htmlFor, and the hint and error are linked by id.

The hint and error are linked with aria-describedby, the value is kept as a string and parsed with the shared parser, and the blur bug that displayed "-0,01" after clearing is fixed (same change as F1394). I did not switch to the shared Field component: it would change this file's hint and error color classes, and colors are out of scope. The wiring is equivalent: label htmlFor, describedby, and aria-invalid only after blur.

Added details: Record<string, unknown> | null to QuoteState. On an error response it is set from body.details when that is a plain object ({ restriction, ...params } for RESTRICTED); every other path sets null. BookingWidget's errorText/OVER_CAPACITY part belongs to its owner (p061).

results.summary: AddToCartButton no longer sets `disabled` while busy. It uses aria-disabled/aria-busy, and add() returns early when busy, so focus stays on the button. On success, if the button had focus, focus moves to the 'Sepete git' link that replaces it. The PriceInsight.tsx part ('Fiyat alarmı kur') is filed as crossOwner.

AddToCartButton has a new optional `childCount` prop. It sends `children: childCount ?? 0` to /api/cart/items, sets guests to adults+children in the login return URL, and writes adults/children only when the caller provides childCount. The widget's adults/children inputs and the property page URL reading belong to their owners (crossOwner widget#3 in p061/p030); the prop name is given in crossOwner.

Each result is stored with a key (room, plan, dates, adults, children) and shown only while the selection matches it, so a stale 'Sepete eklendi.' disappears when the selection changes. After success for the same key, the button becomes a 'Sepete git' link, so the same item can't be added twice by accident. A server-side duplicate check is not included.

Already in place: returnUrl() keeps checkIn/checkOut/guests/roomId/ratePlanId plus intent=add-to-cart, an effect finishes the add on return and clears the intent, and the signed-out hint (cart.add.loginHint, linked via aria-describedby) warns before the redirect. As part of F1025, guests in that URL is now the adults+children total.

The single aria-live wrapper is gone. Success now goes in an always-present `role="status"` div and errors in an always-present `role="alert"` div. The hint id comes from useId() (it was a hard-coded duplicate-prone id) and is linked to the button with aria-describedby.

The hardcoded `children: 0` is replaced by the optional `childCount` prop (named so to avoid eslint react/no-children-prop). The login return URL sets guests to the total, and adults/children when childCount is given. BookingWidget must pass `childCount={children}` (see crossOwner).

CompareBar now sits at `bottom: var(--cookie-banner-h, 0px)`, and its body/scroll padding is `calc(<bar>px + var(--cookie-banner-h, 0px))`. A MutationObserver restores the padding when CookieConsent overwrites or clears the shared style fields, and the banner's last value is put back on unmount. The fix only takes effect once CookieConsent publishes --cookie-banner-h (crossOwner).

Already fixed (F90): CompareBar always renders `

` outside the `visible` condition. It announces the count, plus 'Karşılaştırmaya hazır.' from 2 items and the full hint at 4, and search/page.tsx always mounts CompareBar. It now also announces 'Karşılaştırma seçimi temizlendi.' after clearing.

results.summary: Two parts were already done when I started: the decision select had no default ('Seçin…'), and 'Dayanak' only rendered when REMOVED was picked. I added the missing feedforward. Required fields now use Field `required` (visual * plus required attribute), with a RequiredLegend at the top of the takedown card and of the notice list. This covers İlan kimliği, Gerekçe, the new receipt time, Karar, Dayanak, Olgular and Kapatma gerekçesi. Facts got a minimum-length hint (factsHint) and reason got one too (reasonHint). The AppealQueue part needs nothing: it no longer preselects REJECTED.

Confirmed: in EN, codes like NOTICE_DECIDED fell through to the generic 'unexpected error'. Server error codes now map to new compliance.admin.errors.* keys: NOT_FOUND gives propertyNotFound (create), takedownNotFound (close) or noticeNotFound (decide); TAKEDOWN_CLOSED, NOTICE_DECIDED and TAKEDOWN_DUPLICATE get their own messages, and for the stale cases the list is also reloaded. VALIDATION_ERROR spreads details.fieldErrors onto the matching Field errors (errors.fields.*), shows a summary and focuses the first invalid field. Anything else still goes through useErrorText.

Part of this was already in place: form.reset() and preview clearing ran after a successful save. I added: focus moves to the first field (td-source) after success, the receipt-time field resets to now, and the success message names the listing. The optional server-side duplicate check is passed to the owner as a crossOwner item; the client already handles its TAKEDOWN_DUPLICATE code.

Added a required datetime-local field 'Yazının alındığı tarih ve saat (TSİ)' (receivedAt). Its hint says the 24-hour deadline starts from this moment. It is prefilled with the current Turkey time and refreshed while the admin hasn't edited it; max is kept at now. The value is sent as ISO with a fixed +03:00 offset (Turkey has had no DST since 2016).

The transparency card now has a 'Rapor dönemi' fieldset with labelled Start/End date inputs (end date inclusive) and aria-pressed presets: This year, Last year, Last 6 months. The report URL is built from this state, with the end date sent as the next day because the API's `to` is exclusive. Missing dates or an end before the start show Field errors and hide the links. The CSV link has `download`; the JSON link opens in a new tab (target=_blank rel=noopener) and its visible text says '(yeni sekmede açılır)'.

Every result is now shown next to its action and names the item. Takedown create/close and notice decision messages now include the listing, the request label or the content URL. When the item drops out of the list (closing in the Open filter, deciding a notice, stale 404/409), the message goes to a status region on the list or card, and focus moves to the neighbouring item's heading or the list heading. The parts in AccessibilityPanel, AppealQueue and PromotionsPanel are listed under crossOwner.

Added an h3 'Kayıtlı talepler' and an Open/Closed/All filter using aria-pressed (default Open), with a status region below it. Open fetches ?status=RECEIVED and ?status=ACTIONED, so the 200-row cap cannot push open requests out. Open requests are sorted by slaDueAt ascending, with closed ones after them. Each filter has its own empty message, and rows from a previous filter are never shown while the new ones load.

Each row now has an h4 title (source · document no, or the receipt time) and a <dl> with Listing, Evrak no, Durum, receipt time and SLA due. results.summary: The success card now has the h2 (which gets focus), a confirmation line naming the email address, and the reference in monospace split into groups of 5 (the copied value has no spaces). Next to it is a 'Numarayı kopyala' button with a role=status result line (copied / copy failed) and a support hint. Below come a 3-item 'Bundan sonra ne olacak?' list (human review, decision and reasons by email, DSA Art. 20 appeal) and actions: 'İlana dön' (/property/{id}, only when a listing was linked), 'Ana sayfaya dön', and 'Başka bir içerik bildir', which resets to an empty, unlinked form and focuses the URL field.

The form now has noValidate. A VALIDATORS map mirrors noticeInputSchema on the client and checks every field in one pass, including the good-faith checkbox, which gets its own aria-invalid, aria-describedby and inline error. Errors stay inline under each field through the shared Field error prop, the same pattern AppealForm uses. A summary at the top links to each invalid field, and focus moves to the first invalid field after render. Each error clears once its field becomes valid, via one form-level onChange.

The URL field now has a hint: an example full address, plus a note that the listing page's 'Bu ilanı bildir' link fills the field. An address without a scheme gets https:// added on blur and on submit, so 'www.ornek.com/ilan/123' is accepted. Validation only accepts http and https. When propertyId is set, a read-only summary card replaces the URL input: title, city and thumbnail when the page supplies them, plus the address, and a 'Başka bir içerik bildir' button that unlinks the listing. The title, city and photo need the report/page.tsx change (crossOwner). The optional listing search was not added.

Confirmed: the default URL read window.location during render, which causes a hydration mismatch, and propertyId was always sent even after the user edited the URL. The fix adds two optional props, contentUrl (built on the server) and property {title, city, imageUrl}. Without contentUrl, the origin comes from useSyncExternalStore with an empty server snapshot, so there is no hydration mismatch. While a listing is linked the URL cannot be edited. The only way to change it is 'Başka bir içerik bildir', which drops propertyId, so propertyId is never sent with a different URL. Fetching the title and building the URL on the server belong to report/page.tsx (crossOwner).

Confirmed for the 'listing not found' dead end. A 400 that carries fieldErrors.propertyId, or no fieldErrors at all, for a linked notice is now treated as 'listing not found'. The form unlinks the listing, puts the address in an editable URL field with the error 'Bu ilan artık bulunamadı…', and moves focus there, so resubmitting works. Other 400 fieldErrors map to their Field errors and the summary instead of the generic text. Two parts are left to their owners (crossOwner): an explicit not-found signal from dsa.ts, and AppealForm's mapping of 403, 404 and NOTICE_NOT_DECIDED.

results.summary: Confirmed the bug: useLoader keeps old data while the new request runs. The features and photos loaders now return their data tagged with the propertyId it was fetched for. The list, the photo options and the duplicate check only use data whose tag matches the selected listing, so 'Özellikler yükleniyor…' shows while the new listing loads. The Add button is disabled during loading. Changing the listing resets scope, evidence, drafts, the edit form and status. Errors now go through useErrorText instead of errorMessage.

Added a new module, src/components/host/host-photos-changed.ts, with the HOST_PHOTOS_CHANGED_EVENT constant and notifyHostPhotosChanged(propertyId). The panel listens for this window event and bumps photosVersion, which is in the deps of both the photos and features loaders. A deleted photo also clears evidence on the server, which is why features reload too. The panel only refreshes once HostDashboard's PhotoUpload dispatches the event (see crossOwner).

Photo-list sync works the same way as F823 (event plus photosVersion; HostDashboard must dispatch it). Picking evidence was already a local draft saved with an explicit 'Kanıtı kaydet' button with busy state, so it no longer reverts mid-request. The result of saving evidence, editing, or a failed delete now shows inside that row: a role=status region that is always present for success, and role=alert for errors. Other results stay at the bottom of the card.

Already fixed in the current code. run() keeps busy state with a re-entry guard (`if (busy) return false`). The Add, Delete and Save Evidence buttons pass busy={busy === key}, so Button sets aria-busy and blocks the click. That also blocks implicit Enter submission, because it goes through the submit button's click. The new Edit save button uses the same guard, and Add is also disabled while the list is loading.

The host dashboard mostly says 'İlan'/'Listing', so the panel now uses that. host.intro now reads 'İlanınızın…' / "your listing's…" instead of 'Tesisinizin'. The scope option, list rows and delete-confirm scope use the new key host.wholeListing ('İlanın tamamı' / 'Entire listing') instead of 'Tüm tesis'. wholeProperty is unchanged because guest pages and the admin queue use it. The revenue keys belong to the RevenueDashboard owner (see crossOwner).

Each row now shows its note ('Not: {note}'). A new 'Düzenle' toggle (aria-expanded/aria-controls) opens an inline noValidate form: width appears only for the WIDTH_CODE feature, with range validation and focus on error; the note is always there. It sends PATCH {note, widthCm?}. Hints say a note change keeps verification and a width change removes it, and a confirm dialog appears when the width of a verified feature changes. Save and Cancel return focus to the Edit button.

Scope is now a controlled field. Codes already declared for the selected listing and scope are disabled options labelled '(zaten eklendi)'. When nothing is picked, the default is the first code not yet added for that scope; this also applies after a successful add. If the host picks a duplicate (for example by changing scope afterwards), the code Field shows an error wired with aria-invalid/aria-describedby, and submitting focuses the code select instead of posting.

The add form (and the new edit form) are noValidate. Width is checked by a shared parseWidth(): validity.badInput, Number.isInteger and the MIN/MAX range. On error it sets the Field error and focuses the width input. widthError is cleared when the code changes.

Clicking it opens that listing card's <details>, waits for the PhotoUpload input #photo-{id} to render, then scrolls to it and focuses it. If the card is missing, the link falls back to normal anchor navigation.

results.summary: The property form now tracks a dirty state by comparing the form with the server values; a successful save is snapshotted so it doesn't count as dirty while reloading. Editing clears the old 'Kaydedildi.' message and shows a live 'Kaydedilmemiş değişiklikler var.' label next to Save. A new useHostUnsavedChanges hook adds a beforeunload warning for the property, add-room (room name typed), calendar (price or availability entered but not applied) and new-listing forms. Save is deliberately left enabled when nothing changed: it still answers with the existing property.noChanges message, which is easier to discover than a disabled button.

This shares the F838 dirty indicator, status clearing and beforeunload warning. In-app navigation does not fire beforeunload, so the dashboard's Revenue, Payouts and Resolution links and both booking-message links now use Next Link onNavigate with a useConfirm dialog ('Kaydetmeden ayrıl' / 'Sayfada kal') whenever any host form is dirty. The site-wide header links are outside this file and are covered only by beforeunload on full page loads.

RoomList now shows an empty state ('Henüz oda yok. Takvim ve fiyatları yönetmek için önce aşağıdan oda ekleyin.') instead of an empty <ul>. When the property has no rooms, the calendar section still appears with its heading and explains that the calendar is managed per room and a room must be added first.

The room price field label changed from 'Fiyat farkı' to the new key rooms.add.priceModifierLabel, 'Gecelik ek ücret ({currency})'. The existing hint stays linked through Field's aria-describedby. A live example below the field shows 'Bu odanın gecelik fiyatı: {total} (taban {base} + {modifier})'; AddRoomForm got a new optional basePriceMinor prop for it.

The room surcharge label now includes the currency (see F841). The calendar price label is the new calendar.priceLabel, 'Gecelik fiyat ({currency}) — boş bırakılırsa değişmez'. A live summary under the form, linked to the submit button with aria-describedby, reads 'Uygulanacak: {room}, {from} – {to} (n gece) — gecelik fiyat X olacak, satışa kapatılacak'. Ranges longer than 31 nights now ask for confirmation before submitting.

The start date already had min=today and the end date had min=from (checked in the code); the end date now also gets max=from+364 days through a new addIsoDays helper. The selected night count ('N gece seçili') moved out of the non-live field hint into an aria-live paragraph, which shows the full change summary once a change is entered.

Most of this was already in place: min dates, client-side checks for range errors, and a confirm dialog for 'Satışa kapat'. Added the max end date and the live 'N gece' / change summary. The close-for-sale confirmation now also says when the nightly price will change at the same time (calendar.closeConfirmPrice).

Added the live summary of what will be applied (room, range, night count, price, open/close), linked to the submit button. Ranges over 31 nights now need confirmation (calendar.bulkConfirm), and closing for sale was already confirmed. The 'Geri al' (undo) button was not done: the PUT availability API does not return previous per-night prices or availability, so a correct undo would need a new server contract.

ListingCopy got a new optional onApply prop. PropertyPanel passes applyDraft, which puts the draft into the description field (it does not save), clears any stale saved message and moves focus to the description textarea; the dirty indicator then shows. Each language draft has its own 'Türkçe/İngilizce metni açıklamaya aktar' button, and a status message confirms the transfer. The draft label text now explains to transfer the draft, edit it, then press Save.

Besides the 'Açıklamaya aktar' buttons from F846, each draft (TR and EN) has a 'metni kopyala' button using navigator.clipboard, with success and failure feedback in a Status region. The listingCopy.draft text changed to 'Taslak — otomatik yayınlanmaz. Açıklamaya aktarıp düzenleyin, sonra Kaydet düğmesine basın.'; the key is used only in this file.

Confirmed real: PropertyPhoto has no alt or description column (prisma/schema.prisma:1061), and the upload only sends 'file'. Fixing it needs a Prisma schema change plus migration, changes to the photo upload and PATCH API routes, and gallery changes, all outside this package. Adding an input to HostDashboard now would not persist anything and would mislead hosts. The backend parts are listed in crossOwner; the HostDashboard part (an alt-text field per photo in PhotoUpload that sends altText on upload or PATCH) should follow once the API accepts it.

results.summary: Clicking 'Sil' now opens the shared ConfirmDialog (useConfirm, danger tone, so Cancel has focus). The dialog title names the promotion: '«{name}» silinsin mi?' with the confirm button 'Promosyonu sil'. 'Sil' now sits 32px away from the other row actions (flex gap-x-4 plus ml-4), and every row action includes the promotion name as sr-only text. I did not add an undo toast or a '⋯' menu because the confirmation covers the risk.

Client limits now match the server: minNights max is 365 and usageLimit max is 1,000,000. ApiError VALIDATION_ERROR details.fieldErrors are mapped to form fields and shown through Field error, which sets aria-invalid and aria-describedby. Each error is a localized hint of the form 'Bu değer kabul edilmedi. 1 ile 365 arasında…'. A summary appears in the form Status next to the submit button and focusFirstInvalid moves focus to the first bad field. COUPON_CODE_TAKEN is mapped to the coupon field, and other errors go through useErrorText instead of err.message.

Added optional start and end date fields. The end field has min set to the start date, the end day is inclusive (sent as the next local midnight), and the client checks the range and shows a Field error. The table has a new 'Geçerlilik' column (range, from, until or no end date). A 'Yüzde / Sabit tutar' radio group switches between the percent field and an amount field parsed with parseAmountToMinor. The currency comes from the selected listing, or from the shared currency when all listings use one; otherwise the scope field shows an error. The properties prop gained an optional `currency`, which HostDashboard already passes.

In this file, promotion deletion now goes through the shared ConfirmDialog, and the confirm button names the action ('Promosyonu sil' or 'Promosyonu durdur'). Unifying the destructive-button look with a dangerOutline Button variant is skipped because color/theme is out of scope. The other files listed belong to other packages, and AccessibilityPanel and HostDashboard already use useConfirm.
Each type now has its own default condition (EARLY_BIRD 30, LAST_MINUTE 3, LONG_STAY 7). Changing the type resets the condition to that default instead of carrying the old value over.

After a successful pause or activate, the panel shows '«{name}» durduruldu.' or '«{name}» etkinleştirildi.' in the list Status (role=status). Focus then returns to the same row's toggle button after the list reloads, even if the row moves.

The delete confirmation now states the outcome in advance. For a used promotion it says it was used N times, cannot be deleted and will be paused instead. For an unused one it says the delete is permanent. A used promotion that is already paused gets an explanation and no API call. The numeric priority input is now a Düşük/Normal/Yüksek select (-10/0/10), and legacy values stay available as an 'Özel (n)' option.

Row buttons are kept in a ref map and a pending-focus target is applied after the list reloads. After a delete, focus moves to the neighbouring row's 'Düzenle' button, or to the list container (tabIndex=-1, which holds the status and empty text) when no rows are left. After a pause/activate, a paused-instead-of-deleted result, or saving an edit, focus returns to that row's button. Busy rows use aria-disabled plus a click guard instead of disabled. The DepositSettings and HostDashboard parts belong to other packages.

A load error and an action result now render in separate Status elements, so one no longer hides the other (the old code showed `error ?? status.error`). Form results stay next to the submit button. The short highlight on the new row is skipped because it would need a new color.

Each row has a 'Düzenle' button with the promotion name as sr-only text. It fills the form, sets the visible h3 to 'Promosyonu düzenle: {name}' (the form uses aria-labelledby) and moves focus to the name field. Submitting sends a PATCH with every field set explicitly, with null for fields that no longer apply. Edit mode shows 'Değişiklikleri kaydet' and 'Vazgeç', and Vazgeç returns focus to the row. The usage limit's min equals the current usage count.

Already fixed in Header.tsx before this package. Header reads the user from useSessionUserCache, a cache kept at module level that survives the remount on each navigation. The /api/user/me refresh runs in the background and parallel calls share one request. Moving Header into a shared layout would mean changing about 12 page files outside this package, so I did not attempt it.

Header now keeps the last pathname at module level, and notePathname() runs on every pathname change. After a client navigation, if focus has dropped to body and the URL has no hash, focus moves to `#main h1`. If the h1 has not rendered yet, it retries for up to about 1.5 s and then falls back to `main#main`. It adds tabindex=-1 only when needed and removes it on blur. Nothing happens on the first page load, so the skip link stays first in tab order. Per-page metadata titles belong to the segment layout owners.

results.summary: Confirmed the finding, though part of it was already fixed: the limits hint and per-file size/type checks existed, but `multiple`, the remaining-count and the limit state were missing. The input now has `multiple` and files go into a queue with name, size and a remove button. They upload one after another with a visible and announced "Dosya 2/5 yükleniyor: x.jpg" status, and each failed file keeps its translated error. The hint now says how many more files can be added. At the 10-file limit the input is hidden and the reason is shown, and selections beyond the remaining count are refused with a message. I did not add HEIC to `accept`: the installed sharp build decodes only AVIF from the HEIF family (`sharp.format.heif.input.fileSuffix` is `['.avif']`), so HEIC uploads would fail on the server, and leaving it out lets iOS convert photos to JPEG. A HEIC file picked on desktop now gets a clear translated error before upload.

Added a new shared helper, `apiUploadWithProgress` in src/lib/api-upload-progress.ts. It uses XHR `upload.onprogress` and follows the same contract as `apiFetch`: cookie auth, one session refresh on 401, `ApiError` built from the error body, and `TypeError` on network failure. ClaimEvidence uses it to show a `<progress>` bar with an aria-label (file i/n) and a visible percentage that screen readers skip. Size and type are checked when files are selected, before any upload.

The PDF link no longer opens a new tab; it uses `download` and reads "PDF kanıtını indir (dosya {i}/{n}, {size})". Sizes now use Intl unit formatting: bytes under 1 KB, at least 1 kB under 1 MB, otherwise MB. The queued-file list uses the same formatting. Image links now say "(yeni sekmede açılır)" in an sr-only span.

Image alt text is now numbered: "Kanıt fotoğrafı {i}/{n}: {role}, {date}". The role/date caption under images is aria-hidden so it is not read twice. Under PDFs the caption stays readable because the link text does not include role or date.

When the upload fails with ApiError code EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED, the batch stops, feedback.needsVerify is set, and `<ResendVerificationButton />` (from @/components/auth/AuthCard) appears under `<Status>`. The files the user chose stay in the queue. No new i18n keys were needed.

Removed `aria-pressed`. The selected `<li>` now has `aria-current="true"` and a visible "✓ Seçili" badge (existing colours, no palette change). On the selected row the button reads "Ayrıntıya git"; it calls onSelect again, and ClaimAdmin's existing focus counter then moves focus to the detail heading. Each row button has hidden screen-reader context "(type, property)". Focus and scroll to #claim-admin-selected and the two-column desktop layout already existed in ClaimAdmin. ClaimAdmin.closeDetail still searches for aria-pressed and needs one selector change (see crossOwner). Until that change it falls back to the opener ref, so nothing breaks.

Part of this was already done: the list used role-specific text (respondCta for RESPONDENT, awaitingOther for OPENER, slaDue for ADMIN), and ClaimDetail does the same. Added the remaining time before that text, for example "2 gün kaldı · …", or "1 saatten az kaldı" / "Süre doldu". It uses a once-a-minute clock built with useSyncExternalStore, so render stays pure.

The "Ayrıntıyı aç" and "Şimdi yanıtla" links (and the admin button) each have an sr-only suffix "({type}, {property or booking ref})", so they can be told apart in a links list. The minimum target height on desktop is now 24px (`sm:min-h-0` changed to `sm:min-h-[24px]`); mobile stays at 44px.

Same change as F952. `aria-pressed` is gone, the li has `aria-current="true"`, there is a visible text badge with an icon, and the selected row's button text changes to "Ayrıntıya git". Colour is no longer the only signal.

Added the hidden link context (type and property). The full booking id in bookingRef is replaced by the short last-8 reference that HostDashboard already uses. Showing the check-in date instead needs a `checkIn` field in ClaimSummary and the claims list APIs, which other packages own (see crossOwner). The card is not a stretched link, but targets meet the 24px/44px minimums.

It also refreshes when the tab becomes visible if the last check is stale. Added a "Yazışmayı yenile" button and "Son kontrol: {time}". New messages from others are counted against the previous list and announced in a polite live region. New optional props: live, onRefresh, refreshing.

At 3600+ characters a polite live note warns about the limit, and over 4000 it says by how much. Submitting an empty or too-long message shows a field error and moves focus to the field; the button is no longer silently disabled. The description gets the same near/over-limit live note, a trim-based too-short error that includes the current count, and a too-long error.

New OpenClaimSummaryCard.tsx shows the open claim: status badge, type, amount, SLA date and the next step, with a primary 'Kanıt ekle' link (/resolution/{id}#claim-evidence) and a 'Talebi görüntüle' link. With justCreated it shows the success text and moves focus to 'Kanıt ekle' (aria-describedby carries the success and next-step text). The panel's reload then unmounts the form, so BookingResolutionPanel must render the same card for openOwnClaim (crossOwner) to keep focus and the summary.

The host hint gets the deposit amount and the note that any excess is only recorded. The live preview says how much is above the deposit, and a notice paragraph appears when the booking has no deposit. The panel must pass these props and the deposit API must return refundableMinor (crossOwner).

Most of this was already in OpenClaimForm: noValidate, Field error wiring, focus on the first invalid field, and the server amount error bound to the field. Added a separate empty-amount message (amountRequired), the current count in the too-short description error, and a too-long error. Button now uses busy instead of disabled, so focus stays on it. Confirmed: `selected` comes only from useSearchParams, and page.tsx changes it with router.replace, a server round-trip transition. The controlled checkbox therefore snapped back until the new URL committed. The component now keeps the selection in useOptimistic(selected). Each toggle builds the next list from the optimistic value and calls setCurrent(next) and onChange(next) inside React startTransition, so the checkbox, its screen-reader state and the summary count update straight away and rapid clicks add up. The optimistic value clears when the router transition commits the new URL.

The list of 11 checkboxes now sits inside a <details> in the fieldset; the legend and hint stay outside it. The details starts open only when something is selected and is controlled through useState plus onToggle, so it does not slam shut when the user clears the last box. crossOwner.change: Make the location search accent- and İ/ı-insensitive with the new shared helper: import { normalizePlace } from "@/lib/search/normalize-place". When q.length >= 2: const needle = normalizePlace(q); const all = await prisma.location.findMany({ select: { city: true, country: true }, orderBy: { city: "asc" }, take: 1000 }); then filter with normalizePlace(l.city).includes(needle) || normalizePlace(l.country).includes(needle) and keep the first 20 (.slice(0, 20)). crossOwner.change: Add an exported read-only `previewClaim({ token, buyerId, now? }): Promise<{ status: "ok" | "invalid" | "expired" | "gone" | "self"; expiresAt?: string }>` that takes no lock and charges nothing. Logic: decode the token body and, if its exp is past, return 'expired'. If verifyClaimToken(token, now) fails, return 'invalid'. Load bookingTransfer by payload.transferId; if it is missing, tokenHash !== hashToken(token), or bookingId does not match, return 'invalid'. If status !== LISTED, return 'gone'. If sellerId === buyerId, return 'self'. Otherwise return 'ok' with expiresAt. This mirrors the checks in claimLocked (L670-683) without the PSP and attempt counters.
crossOwner.statusNote: src/lib/transfer/transfer-service.ts (r080): fixed — Added exported `previewClaim({ token, buyerId, now? })` and a `ClaimPreviewStatus` type. It takes no lock, makes no PSP call and does not touch attempt counters. It checks the feature flag like claimTransfer, then mirrors claimLocked: signature check → 'invalid', past exp → 'expired', then transfer lookup (missing / tokenHash / bookingId mismatch → 'invalid'), non-LISTED → 'gone', seller is buyer → 'self', otherwise 'ok' with expiresAt as an ISO string. One difference from the request: the token's signature is checked before it is decoded for the expiry check, so a forged token reports 'invalid' rather than 'expired'.

Also add the matching path to src/lib/http/openapi.ts, because tests/unit/lib/openapi-contract.test.ts checks that docs and route files stay in sync. ml-p122.notes:
I edited only src/components/ui/ui.tsx and wrote the message patch msg-ml/p122.json, in the common namespace. It changes loginRequired (adds the register chunk), ai.generated, ai.hint and ai.modes.*, and adds successPrefix and requiredLegend. I grepped every changed key: loginRequired in the common namespace is used only by RoleGate, and ai.* only by LlmBadge.

Where I deviated from the recommended fixes:
(1) Status keeps role="alert" conditional, rendered only while there is an error, rather than an always-present empty alert div. An empty alert div would break the e2e helpers `appAlert(page)` (strict locator) and `calendar.getByRole("alert")).toHaveCount(0)`. Inserting a role=alert element is announced reliably, and the outer aria-live is removed, so the nesting/double announcement is fixed.
(2) successPrefix is "Başarılı:"/"Success:" instead of "Tamam:", because it is clearer.
(3) F387 and F428 are merged: guests see only the fallback qualifier, and staff (audience="staff") see all mode labels with the new non-jargon wording.

New exports, all additive with existing props and signatures unchanged: buttonClass, ButtonLink, RequiredLegend, focusFirstInvalid and usePageHeadingFocus; Button gains size/fullWidth, Field gains required, LlmBadge gains audience.

The inputClass template-literal line and the buttonClass return line are over 100 columns. These are unbreakable strings, as before.

The module-level path record behind usePageHeadingFocus is updated inside a plain helper called from useEffect, so the react-hooks v7 "globals" rule should not flag it.
